title: Interactive Branching Fork
description: Branching narrative fork: crucial decision point with choice options, trait requirements, and consequence flags.
systemPromptDirective: Establish a critical branching juncture with clear divergent stakes, highlighting choices and immediate narrative consequences.

fields.label: Focal Choice Premise
fields.placeholder: e.g., Standing at the control core: purge the infected AI or upload it to the jump drive
fields.helperText: The decisive dilemma confronting the protagonist

fields.label: Choice Options
fields.placeholder: e.g., Option A: Purge the AI; Option B: Preserve the AI in cold storage; Option C: Merge with the neural link
fields.helperText: Available pathways or actions the reader/character can select

fields.label: Consequence Flags
fields.helperText: World state changes or narrative flags triggered by choices

fields.label: Requirements / Thresholds
fields.placeholder: e.g., Requires Tech skill > 6 or Marcus in party
fields.helperText: Pre-conditions or skill checks required to unlock specific branches
